scenes.summary: You arrive at the dam expecting the inspection ceremony Roger invited you to, only to discover that he's prepared a whole feast of honey waffles for everyone.

lines.text: Endmin! You came too!
We gathered way too many spores while clearing out the dam.
So we figured the safest way was to feed them to the Forge of Sweetness and make honey waffles.
I also took the liberty of setting up a honey waffle feast to thank everyone.
Guess the honey waffle feast comes before the final inspection, huh...
Hehe ... you caught me.
Kay, if you don't mind, would you like to try it first?
Mind? Are you kidding?! I'd love to!
Endmin, come eat with me!

options: What's with all these honey waffles?
It's okay. Everyone deserves a feast after all this hard work.
All the spores from the dam are here? No wonder there are so many.

scenes.summary: The honey waffles are delicious. Between bites, you trade updates about the dam, one piece leading to the next. What no one realizes is that the taste is ... peculiar. Dizziness creeps in, the topic drifts into stranger territory, and by the time Roger says he has big news to announce, everything goes dark.

lines.text: Today's honey waffle looks a little different.
The spores from this batch were sweeter, so we tweaked the recipe in the Forge of Sweetness.
Ooh, the giant mushroom got even sweeter? I'm digging in!
Mmm ... it tastes much richer than before.
Thanks to the Sweetbreakers, we cleaned up the dam in no time.
Collecting the spores was all their work. We really misjudged them before.
They weren't born to be our enemies.
You're right. Wish I'd been friends with them sooner...
It's okay! With honey waffles around, everyone can be friends!
Very well said! Here's to honey waffles!
So many years have passed... I've grown old, but the mushroom stays the same...
You sure...?
You have no idea... Back then, I thought about it day and night, just hoping the mushroom would grow...
All these years, I kept wondering what it would look like when it finally did...
Alright, I'll shut up now. It's all in this piece!
You're really ... quite attached to that mushroom...
Truth is ... I called you all back for something important ... something big.
Ooh, what is it? Sounds so mysterious...
Not gonna lie ... it's the biggest thing in my life!
The biggest thing in your life...? Then we must tell more people...
Let's call everyone in Wuling and throw you a proper ... celebration...
And by Talos, I've waited decades for this...

options: Eat who knows how many honey waffles

lines.text: Honey waffle is best when it's warm. Take a seat and try some.

scenes.summary: You wake up in a cluttered room, and Roger is nowhere to be seen.

lines.text: Endmin, wake up!
Argh... My head...
...Kay?
I have no idea. It's like we blinked and ... poof ... we were here.
What were we doing before we got here...?
Uh... I remember we were at the dam ... with Uncle Roger...
Everything's such a mess around here ... maybe if we look around, we'll find some clues!
*Snoring* ...
Did someone knock them out?
I don't see any signs of a fight...
They look more like they drank too much and passed out.

scenes.summary: You run into a conscious Sweetbreaker, and he claims you and Roger threw a party for everyone last night. You have no memory of any of it. Before passing out, he tells you that Roger headed off to the Valley Fort with Rhodagn.

lines.text: Hey, are you alright?
*Cough* ...Are we having another party?
Wait, you don't remember? You two and Roger threw a party last night. Everyone was singing and dancing all night.
Singing and dancing? I don't remember doing that...
Did you say Roger? You saw him with us?
Hah, yeah. He went the hardest last night.
He was singing his heart out. Even in a showdown with Rhodagn, he didn't back down!
A showdown? That explains the big hole in the wall...
He's got some serious chops. First time I ever saw Rhodagn in a tight spot.
But wasn't Rhodagn already...
That brute's not the type to go down easy! I bet they'll be at it for hundreds more rounds before someone wins.
They're probably inside the ⟦key|Fort⟧ by now. Go look for them there.
Just wake me up when the party starts...
A showdown ... a party ... I'm so confused.

scenes.summary: You arrive at the door. It's locked, and no one responds. So you decide to make some noise and wake whoever's in there.

lines.text: No one's answering the door.
Okay, let's make some noise! They can't sleep forever!
Is everyone inside just asleep...?
Hmm ... these goofy little things should do the trick!

scenes.summary: You find Rhodagn completely wasted. After some persistent questioning, he finally tells you: Roger's getting married, and last night was supposed to be his bachelor party. But after everyone ate themselves unconscious, Roger seems to have taken the elevator and slipped off on his own.

lines.text: Yo, big sleepyhead, wake up!
You again? Please, stop stuffing me with honey waffles...
Stop acting so innocent. You guys completely trashed this place.
...We really did?
Don't act like it didn't happen. I've got photos.
Y'all showed up with a mountain of honey waffles and went, "NOBODY LEAVES CONSCIOUS."
That stuff hit harder than kohl. Everyone lost it after a couple of pieces.
You guys went wild, took over the stage, and yelled about the most "unforgettable" bachelor party ever ... and now you don't remember?
Endmin, seems like we had a pretty good time.
We took over the stage ... threw a party ... but why, though?
Oh man ... please tell me you remember the wedding today?
Wedding?!
Who's getting married?
Endmin, are you getting married?
Roger's getting married and you forgot?! Are you guys even friends?
Uncle Roger...? Oh, right! He did say he had something big to announce.
Was it about him getting married?
She's his first love. They met in Wuling.
That guy's ridiculously loyal. He never forgot her, even after all these years apart.
He kept saying he'd protect her for life, go through hell and back for her...
Gotta hand it to him. Never met anyone that devoted before.
He got all sappy, so I teased him a little. Then he took it personally and wouldn't stop stuffing me with honey waffles.
Where's Uncle Roger now?
I asked for a rain check, but he wouldn't have it. Said he was going to Dijiang to get help.
That, I wouldn't know. Last I saw, he was taking that ⟦key|elevator⟧.
He was mumbling about Dijiang being up in the sky and how he needed to get up there too.
If you're trying to find him, go that way.
Give me a shout when the wedding starts. I'm gonna take a quick nap...
Huh? What are you talking about?
Who knew that quiet guy could eat more than Nefarith? We polished off hundreds of pieces. I was done...

options: So what happened between you two last night?
Oh, so that's what the "showdown" was...
You can't just waltz onto Dijiang.

lines.text: Go find Roger already... Let me ... rest a bit more...

scenes.summary: You run into Da Pan, who's waiting to take you to Roger's wedding. He tells you the story of Roger and his bride, then reminds you that you were the one who told everyone to cover Wuling in mushrooms as a wedding gift. Taking his word for it, you decide to prepare the gift before heading out.

lines.text: Endmin, Kay, what took you so long?
Uncle Pan, were you waiting just for us?
Of course! I've been waiting to take you to Roger's wedding! Chop chop, we're gonna be late!
Even you're saying it too? Is Roger really getting married?
Why would I joke about that? Don't you remember, Endmin? You and Tianshi Zhuang got half of Wuling City together for Roger's big day.
No wonder the streets are so empty...
Well, Roger and that girl have always been something special. Everyone wants to be there for them.
Uncle Pan, do you know Uncle Roger's bride?
I sure do! I was there the day they first met.
She's beautiful, a great cook, and she's Roger's muse when it comes to his research.
Roger's a lucky man to have found someone like her.
She sounds amazing...
The bride, the wedding... I can't believe I forgot something this important.
We can't be late. Let's go now!
Wait, it's their big day. We can't just show up empty-handed.
Perfect. I'll tidy up the eatery and wait for you here.
Tianshi Zhuang? I don't remember a thing...
But I don't have anything prepared...
Huh? Didn't you tell us to fill Wuling City with mushrooms as a gift for Roger?
Of course! She was so moved by Roger's story that she planted the very first mushroom herself.
That gift is essential, Endmin. The wedding depends on it.
Alright, I'll take care of the gift.

options: I did? And Tianshi Zhuang was okay with that?

lines.text: Look at all these mushrooms. Let's grab a few nice ones for the happy couple!
Endmin, look! This vending machine has the mushroom we need!
"Roger's wedding song"...? What kind of question is that?
Oooh! It moved! We got it right!
Can't believe he actually picked that song...
But it's kinda different from the others. I think you have to answer a question first.
I don't think that's it...
It's way too noisy.
Let's pick another one!
This one sounds pretty uplifting, but it's not doing anything.
Alright. Next one.
Ohhhh, this one's so classy.
Welp, the vending machine isn't responding... Roger didn't go with this one.
Have you seen the bride? Her makeup is absolutely dreamlike...
Where's the bride?
I saw her in the ⟦key|dressing room⟧. It's that way.
When's the wedding gonna start? This makeup is taking forever!
Endmin, Kay, just the people I wanted to see!
Is Uncle Roger in there with the bride?
The bride's been in the dressing room for hours now...
I'd rather not say it out here...
Oh, maybe you should go in and talk to the bride...

options: What is she doing in there?

scenes.summary: You finally meet Roger's rather unusual bride. It's clear from her words just how much she loves him. She tells you that Roger hasn't shown up all day and that she's deeply worried. To make sure the wedding goes ahead, you decide to go find him.

lines.text: Sweetheart, is that you?
Endmin ... Kay...?
You ... you are Miss Erielle?
Hmm? Endmin, don't you remember me?
We met once in Wuling. You even helped me get better when I was sick.
I'm sorry. I really don't remember much these days...
Please don't worry about it. I'm honored that you're here. I've been hoping to express my thanks to you directly.
Roger's still the same reckless soul I first met. He hasn't changed a bit.
Back then, he was just a research assistant. Completely lost in his work — nothing else seemed to matter.
You two were already together then?
Yes. He was struggling so much with his research ... my heart ached for him...
I wanted to care for him, encourage him, and help him become a great scientist. But then the Blight Tide came ... and tore us apart.
Years passed, and I never received a single letter. I kept wondering...
Was he alright? Had his research succeeded? Was he taking care of himself...?
Endmin, Kay ... thanks to you two, Roger found his way back to me.
Miss Erielle, you've been so strong... But where's Uncle Roger?
*Sigh* That's what's troubling me...
Today's our big day, but he's vanished, and I can't seem to reach him...
When was the last time you saw him?
Last night. He said he was going to his bachelor party with friends...
Bachelor party... Could it be the one in Valley IV...?
I asked his coworkers and friends to look for him, but all they found was this pair of glasses...
Huh? Another pair of Uncle Roger's glasses...?
Wh-what if something bad happened to him at the party?
Don't worry, Miss Erielle. Uncle Roger wouldn't go far!
You want to thank us?
That's right. Thanks to you two, Roger and I were able to meet again.
Do you think ... I should tell everyone we're delaying the wedding?
I'll find him and bring him back safe. Pinky promise!

scenes.summary: After crawling through an eerie stretch of pipes, you end up back in the room where you first woke up. And there's Roger, groggy and disoriented. A few words are enough to jog his memory: his own wedding. The good news is, there's still just enough time to get back.

lines.text: It's the same room from before...
Uncle Roger, you're here!
Where am I...?
My brain feels like it's been drowned in honey waffles...
Wait ... I think there was something important ... what was it?
What? I'm getting married?
Erielle? That sounds very familiar...
I think ... I was at a party? I had a honey waffle eating contest with some big guy ... then went to Wuling City to plant mushrooms...
Oh no! Oh no, no, no! How did I forget something this huge?
Last night, the honey waffles just kept getting better. By the time I came to, it was already morning.
I checked, and that big guy was still knocked out, so I slipped away to the wedding venue...
I was a total wreck. I didn't want my love to give me an earful.
So I thought I'd pick up some of her favorite mushrooms on the way back.
Then I just kept walking ... and somehow ended up here...
It's strange. I've walked this road so many times. How'd I get lost?
Uncle Roger, you had way too many honey waffles last night...
Oh man ... what time is it? The wedding hasn't started yet, has it?
The bride and guests are all waiting for you.
Go, go, go! Don't let Miss Erielle down!

options: Do you remember what you were doing?
So how did you end up here?
You can still make it if you head back now.
A wedding can't start without the groom, can it?

scenes.summary: The moment you press the shutter button, your consciousness dissolves into a haze. It turns out all of this was a dream woven by Strain E21 to fulfill Roger's wish. Now the dream is ending, the wish is about to come true — and it's time to wake up.

lines.text: Where is this?
This is the last moment of a dream. Roger's about to wake up.
We're in his dream? Who are you?
I'm Strain E21. You freed me from the Malignant Hyphal Mass, so I wanted to repay you by fulfilling your wishes.
And now ... Roger's wish is about to come true.
But what was Roger's wish?
"To never be apart again."
Wait—

scenes.summary: You, Kay, and Roger all wake up at the same time. Roger tells you that his success in researching Strain E21 earned him an honorary professorship, fulfilling his wish to be with the mushroom for the rest of his life. So that's where the whole "wedding" came from.

lines.text: Uncle Roger, don't put a ring on the pressure valve...
I didn't!
Huh? Did we just take a little nap?
What about the wedding? Where's Miss Erielle?
Wait ... you had that dream too?
Aww ... it was all just a dream...?
But then why is the wedding invitation from the dream here...?
Oh, you mean this...?
"Notice of Appointment of Professor Roger Aigers as Tenured Professor of Mycology" ...Tenured professor?
I've devoted most of my life to researching edible fungi.
I poured my heart and soul into Strain E21, but the Blight Tide kept me from seeing how it turned out...
Now that I know it's thriving, it proves my methods actually worked!
The union has recognized my work and entrusted me with running this ecological park.
So you get to stay with the giant mushroom forever?
Exactly! That is what I wanted to thank you for when I invited you back.
If it weren't for you, Strain E21 and I would never have had a future.
So that's what the "wedding" was really about...
From now on, I can spend the rest of my life taking care of Strain E21 ... we'll never be apart again!
Yayyy! Here's to Uncle Roger and the giant mushroom's happily ever after!
Let's celebrate with more honey waffles!
No thanks!

options: About you and Rhodagn being best buddies?
About planting mushrooms all over Wuling?
That sounds very much like a wedding vow...

lines.text: Hmm? So many mushrooms here too.
Oh, hey, it's you. The party last night was wild...
Have you seen the guy who came with us?
Roger? Big bro Rhodagn took him...
What? Rhodagn? Rhodagn's here too?
Hey, don't fall asleep again! Wake up!
Whoa, this is such a big hole.
Did we get into a fight with someone?
I have a bad feeling about this. Let's head out and check.
This access panel was always shut. Who opened it?
Phew... I finally made it back.
Where did you run off to? I was worried sick...
Good thing the Endmin and Kay found you...
I'm just happy to see you two happy together!
My love, I promise you ... we'll never be apart again!
Yes... Never ever again!
Endmin, would you mind taking a picture of us?
Was there a fight here?
Endmin ... this day is finally here. I still can't believe it's real...
Yes! I'm ready!
This time, nothing will keep us apart!
This scarf smells like Uncle Roger...
Are these Uncle Roger's glasses?

options: I hope he hasn't run into any trouble.
